user.title: DomotiApp Lovelace
user.description: There is nothing to configure. Confirm to install the card; it will then be available on every dashboard.

abort.already_configured: DomotiApp Lovelace has already been added.

confirm.title: Delete scenes
confirm.description:
You are about to delete the stored scenes of:

**{groep}**

This cannot be undone. Afterwards the data can only be recovered from a backup.

The light group itself and the card remain; the scenes can be set up again.

data.bevestigd: Yes, delete the scenes of this light group

scenes.title: Clean up stored scenes
scenes.description:
Choose the light group whose stored scenes you want to delete. Each entry shows how many lights are configured per scene, so you can see whether there is work in it.

Nothing is deleted yet; you will be asked to confirm.

alarmcode.title: Alarm code
alarmcode.description:
The alarm panel card asks for this code before it disarms. Arming needs no code.

{stand}

The code is stored hashed and cannot be read back — not even by you. If you forget it, simply set a new one here.

**Note:** this locks the card, not Home Assistant. Anyone who can log in to Home Assistant can disarm from the developer tools. If your alarm system has a code of its own, use that one — the card passes it through.

data.wissen: Remove the code (the card will stop asking)

error.bevestiging_vereist: Tick the box to confirm, or close this dialog to delete nothing.
error.code_leeg: Enter a code, or tick the box to remove the existing one.
error.code_te_kort: A code shorter than four characters is too easy to guess.
error.code_ongelijk: The two codes do not match. Try again.

abort.niets_opgeslagen: There is nothing stored to clean up yet.
abort.niet_gevonden: This light group is no longer in storage; nothing was deleted.
abort.niet_geladen: DomotiApp Lovelace is not loaded. Try again once the integration is running.
abort.opslag_onbruikbaar: The storage file does not have the expected shape, so there is nothing to clean up per light group. See the repair issue for the way out.

corrupte_opslag.title: Stored scenes are unreadable
corrupte_opslag.description:
The stored scenes for {entity_id} do not match the expected format and have therefore been preserved untouched: {reden}

The scenes for this room cannot be edited while this is the case. Remove the storage for this light group via Configure on DomotiApp Lovelace; after that the scene can be set up again. Until then the old values remain in .storage/domotiapp_lovelace.scenes.

opslag_onbruikbaar.title: Stored scenes are unusable
opslag_onbruikbaar.description:
The storage file {opslagsleutel} can be read, but its contents do not have the expected shape: {reden}.

Nothing is read or written while this is the case, so the file stays intact. Every scene card reports that the storage is unreadable.

How to recover: restore .storage/domotiapp_lovelace.scenes from a backup, or delete the file to start fresh. Then restart Home Assistant or reload the integration. If you deleted the file, the scenes can be set up again per room.
